description: This Go source file defines a package 'artifacts' which provides functionality for managing and fetching build artifacts (such as CVD bundles, kernel images, and bootloader images) for an Android-based project. It contains structures and methods related to downloading, caching, and organizing artifacts, primarily via remote fetchers and a registry system to avoid redundant downloads.

classes.name: Manager
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing the fetching and organization of build artifacts such as CVD bundles, kernels, and bootloaders.

classes.name: ExtraCVDOptions
classes.description: Options for additional configuration when fetching a CVD bundle, such as system image build ID and target.

classes.name: registry
classes.description: Internal class managing cached download contexts to prevent redundant downloads.

classes.name: downloadContext
classes.description: Contains information about a particular download operation, its lock, and its state (completed, error).

methods.name: NewManager
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Manager instance with specified root directory and UUID generator function.

methods.name: GetCVDBundle
methods.description: Fetches a CVD bundle, either full or custom, using a fetcher, and returns the output directory.

methods.name: GetKernelBundle
methods.description: Fetches the kernel bundle (bzImage and initramfs) for a given build and target, caching the result.

methods.name: GetBootloaderBundle
methods.description: Fetches the bootloader (u-boot.rom) artifact for a given build and target, caching the result.

methods.name: GetOrDownload
methods.description: In the registry, runs the fetch function only once per directory to prevent duplicate downloads.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the download function if not already done and caches the result.
